name: Everything Bagel Deviled Eggs (Smoked Salmon, Sesame and Caraway Seeds, and Dried Onion)

ingredients.name: hard-boiled eggs, peeled and halved lengthwise
fresh lemon juice, from 1 whole lemon
toasted sesame seeds, plus more for garnish
toasted dehydrated minced onion, plus more for garnish
toasted caraway seeds, plus more for garnish
minced smoked salmon, plus more for garnish

instructions.primary_message: Place all of the yolks in a medium bowl. Select 8 of the best looking egg white halves and set aside. Reserve the remaining 4 for another use. Add cream cheese, mayonnaise, lemon juice, sesame seeds, dehydrated onion, caraway seeds, and smoked salmon to yolks and, using a sturdy whisk, mash and stir together until thoroughly combined. Season with salt.

Transfer yolk filling to zipper-lock bag. Filling and egg white halves can be stored covered in the refrigerator up to overnight before filling and serving (lay egg white halves cut-side-down on a large plate and cover with plastic wrap). Cut off corner of zipper-lock bag and pipe filling mixture into egg white halves, overstuffing each hole. Garnish deviled eggs with sesame seeds, dehydrated onion, caraway seeds, smoked salmon, and scallions. Serve immediately.

schema_metadata.keywords: appetizer, deviled egg, egg, hors d'oeuvre, smoked salmon, snack

description: Inspired by everything bagels, these deviled eggs have onion, sesame seed, and caraway seed, along with cream cheese and smoked salmon.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Thinly sliced scallions, for garnish

Optional substitutions: hard-boiled eggs → hard-steamed eggs
author: Daniel Gritzer
